meta.source: maps.metmuseum.org official map, pixel-traced. Department regions hand-traced from the screenshot, snapped to building walls.
meta.aligned: All four floors share the same viewBox and pixel registration — the building sits in the same place when you switch floors.
meta.layers: walls = building outline + room dividers (light context lines). departments = one outlined region per department (the main layer). Each department is a contiguous wall-bounded area; no overlaps, none cross the building footprint.
meta.recommended_style: walls: stroke #9aa3b0 width 0.6, fill none. departments: stroke <color> width 1.5-2, fill <color> opacity 0.15-0.22, plus a centered label.
